column1: Source: monthly result pages of the International Astronomical Center ICOP (astronomycenter.net/icop), downloaded 19 Oct 2026 by the project owner for private research. Copyright IAC; do not publish or redistribute. Permission was requested by email.
Parsed by tests/icop_parse.js and tests/icop_fields.js in the moon-visibility project; nothing was corrected by hand.
Sheet "Reports": one row per observer report (7426 rows).
Sheet "Engine_Scores": project engine output for the 5383 reports that have a naked-eye label (seen / not seen), coordinates and an observing window.

column2: page code + running number on that page (stable only for this download)
which ICOP month page the report is on
waxing (new) = evening crescent; waning (old) = morning crescent
Gregorian date of the observation as shown on the page (local civil date of the session)
After sunset / Before sunrise / Before sunset (daytime) / After sunrise (daytime), as reported
as entered by the reporter (some in Arabic script or with typos)
from city_lat_lon.csv (Zenodo-derived city list); EMPTY for 901 reports whose place is not in that list. City-centre accuracy only, not the observing site.
ICOP member name as printed (public on the page)
ICOP headline: Seen / Not Seen / Photographed / Seen by others (any instrument, or by other people)
reporter-chosen words: sky = clear/partly cloudy/cloudy; atmosphere = superb/clear/hazy/very hazy
seen / not seen / not sought, per instrument. Use naked_eye for visibility work; "seen by others" and photographs can still have naked_eye = not seen.
the reporter's own words and the whole page text (clock times, altitudes etc. are only here, unparsed)
length of the session window scored: evening sunset..moonset; morning moonrise..sunrise; daytime Moon-up and Sun-up part of the day
maximum over the window of log10(contrast/threshold); raw > 0 means visible; calibrated (zeta 100) visible if >= 0.5. Aerosol k_a 0.15, RH 0.5 for every row (the real dust is unknown)
Bruin Fig 9 margin in degrees (>0 visible); outside design range in daytime/morning
Yallop q at best time; evening rows only
1 seen, 0 not seen (the label the scores are compared with)

column1: Known limits: labels are self-reported; some reporters are in cloud or haze; coordinates are city-level; scores test "visible at any time in the session", not the clock time of first sight; daytime classes are small and noisy.
